shortcut_name: Direct additive minima from isolated constraints
evidence: gpt-oss: "if 1 + p1 + p2 > deadline" and "if 1 + sum1 > deadline"; qwen: "Minimum completion time for item i is 1 + p1 + p2"; glm: "alpha = p1 + p2 + 1" and accumulated "load1"/"load2"
affordance_in_statement: The projection of its valid solution space onto the C2,i coordinate forms a closed ray [ α_i, ∞ ); ... constraints (1), (2), and (3) ... The projection ... onto ... max_k Cc,k forms a closed ray [ β_c, ∞ ).
secondary_shortcut_name: Guaranteed existence of one certificate type
removal_suggestion: Re-present the certificate conditions through the original schedule semantics rather than explicitly describing isolated subsystems as rays with infima; omit the explanatory closed-form interpretation and require contestants to derive which subsystem is infeasible.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Computes each job's minimum completion as 1+p1+p2, then compares 1+sum(p1) and 1+sum(p2) for facility loads.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The isolated JOB subsystem uses constraints (1), (2), and (3), while the LOAD subsystem uses the per-facility non-intersection constraints.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Uses the explicit minimum completion formula "1 + p1 + p2" and checks additive facility workloads.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: S2,k ≥ S1,k + p1,k together with the completion-time definitions and non-overlapping intervals.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Sets "alpha = p1 + p2 + 1" and accumulates p1 and p2 as facility loads.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The JOB and LOAD projections are explicitly defined as closed rays whose lower endpoints are the relevant minima.

common_affordance: The statement decomposes infeasibility into isolated single-job and single-facility subsystems whose lower endpoints are obtained by simply adding the mandatory start offset and processing durations.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It omits the mandatory start-time offset: it tests p1+p2 > T+1 instead of 1+p1+p2 > T+1, and tests sum(p) > T+1 instead of 1+sum(p) > T+1, so it misses boundary certificates.

recommended_edit: Remove the explicit ray/projection decomposition and its explanatory closed-form presentation, replacing it with an equivalent operational description in which contestants must infer the isolated job and facility lower bounds from the schedule constraints.
